issues.display_title: Issue #1488: Migrate Nadir: Nadir Patching Endpoints
issues.main_description_html:
Pattern: Category B � already delegates to Action class. Wrap to strict ADR (DTO + ExceptionMapper + ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelope). No logic change.

Controller: Tours\\NadirController ? split into 4 single-action controllers.

Endpoints:

Method Endpoint Current method
POST /nadir/patch nadirPatch
POST /nadir/mirror-ball createNadirMirrorBall
POST /nadir/patch-mirror nadirMirrorPatch
POST /nadir-go/pathcer nadirPatcher

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md, docs/ARCH_RULES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1493. Tours\\NadirController nadir patching endpoints were migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR by splitting them into 4 single-action controllers with DTOs, mapped domain exceptions, and ResponseEnvelopeHelper envelopes.

Key changes:

  • Tours\\NadirController reduced by removing 4 legacy handlers and routing them to dedicated controllers
  • 4 new Action classes: NadirPatchAction, CreateNadirMirrorBallAction, NadirMirrorPatchAction, NadirPatcherAction
  • 4 new DTOs: NadirPatchDto, CreateNadirMirrorBallDto, NadirMirrorPatchDto, NadirPatcherDto
  • 3 new domain exceptions with stable codes (TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_BELONG, TOURS.NADIR_NOT_FOUND, TOURS.PANORAMA_NOT_FOUND)
  • Supporting services/repository extended: ConstellationService, RabbitMQService::publishDev(), ToursRepository::getGlobalNadirUpload()
  • Legacy bug fixed on /nadir/patch with type_patch=all: publishing no longer disconnects RabbitMQ inside the loop, so all panos are queued correctly

Affected API endpoints:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
POST /nadir/patch Queues nadir patch processing for one pano or all panos in a moderation, preserving legacy payload/envelope behavior. nadir-patch.md
POST /nadir/mirror-ball Creates nadir mirror ball output for a panorama via the migrated ADR action/controller flow. create-nadir-mirror-ball.md
POST /nadir/patch-mirror Queues mirror patch processing with preserved LIVE-only publish behavior and legacy success envelope. nadir-mirror-patch.md
POST /nadir-go/pathcer Queues nadir patcher jobs while preserving the legacy route path, queue payload echo, and validator error shape. nadir-patcher.md

Error domain codes introduced:

Code HTTP When
TOURS.MODERATION_NOT_BELONG 409 Moderation does not belong to the authenticated user
TOURS.NADIR_NOT_FOUND 409 Requested nadir or moderation-related nadir record was not found
TOURS.PANORAMA_NOT_FOUND 409 Requested panorama record was not found

This issue is resolved via PR #1503. Hashtag\HashtagController@getHashtagModeration was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change. This is also the first PR in the 6-PR Hashtag domain migration stack (#1497, #1498, #1499, #1500, #1501, #1502), so it introduces the Hashtag ADR domain scaffold used by the rest of the stack.

Method Endpoint Description API Docs

This issue is resolved via PR #1505. Hashtag\HashtagController@addHashtags was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change. This is PR 3 of 6 in the Hashtag domain migration stack (after #1503 for #1497, #1504 for #1500), extending the same Hashtag ADR scaffold.

Key changes:

  • New Hashtag\Moderation\AddHashtagsController → AddHashtagsAction → HashtagRepository + AddHashtagsDto (userId, typeSelect, tags, moderationIds, exceptionIds, types, oldTags, search)

Endpoint: GET /hashtag/lists
Current code: Hashtag\HashtagController@listHashtags
Category: B — already delegates to Hashtag\Actions\ListHashtags, so this is a mechanical conformance pass. Wrap with DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope.

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md

Note from Developer

This issue is resolved via PR #1504. Hashtag\HashtagController@listHashtags was migrated to strict Domain-Based ADR — mechanical wrap only, no behavior change. This is PR 2 of 6 in the Hashtag domain migration stack (after #1503 for #1497), reusing the Hashtag ADR scaffold introduced there.

Key changes:

  • New Hashtag\Moderation\ListHashtagsController → ListHashtagsAction → HashtagRepository::getHashtagListForUser() + ListHashtagsDto
  • Distinct-tag count + grouped/paginated tag-usage list query mirrors legacy ListHashtags::execute() 1:1
  • Preserved a legacy quirk verbatim: (int) $request->limit ?? 10 never actually falls back to 10 (an (int) cast is never null), so an absent limit/page resolves to 0 — documented in code/docs so it isn't "fixed" by accident later
  • DB failures are not swallowed here (unlike Get Hashtag Moderation) — matches legacy, which had no try/catch around its query
  • Legacy HashtagController::listHashtags() method + app/Http/Controllers/Hashtag/Actions/ListHashtags.php removed (other legacy methods untouched, handled by later PRs in the stack)

Affected API endpoint:

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
GET /hashtag/lists Returns a paginated, tag-filterable list of distinct hashtags used by the authenticated user, with usage counts. list-hashtags.md

Error domain codes introduced: none — this endpoint had no input validation in the legacy Action, so no new domain exception was needed.

Key changes:

  • New Hashtag\Moderation\DeleteHashtagsController → DeleteHashtagsAction → HashtagRepository + DeleteHashtagsDto
  • Validates tag is a non-empty string, rejects protected system-default hashtags (googlebusiness, nonbusinessgoogle, blueline, hostedtour, realestate, sidemenucontrolbar), then delegates to the repository

No caller found in this backend-only repo; migrated faithfully per the issue regardless. Flagged in the doc for a human decision on deprecating the route later.

Method Endpoint Description API Docs
